title: Sorting
intro: What you want to know of each email — where it stands, how urgent it is, who takes care of it — and who decides it. Boards filter on them.
name: Name
valuesHint: Type a value and press Enter. Click its dot to choose its colour.
fixed: The name and the values of a pre-configured attribute are fixed: the application relies on them.
ruleIntro: Written in Elo, a small expression language: it costs nothing to run and says exactly what it does. It is given the email as _ and answers a value, or null to say nothing.
confirmDelete: Delete the attribute “{name}”? Boards stop filtering on it.
sortAgain: Save and apply to the emails already kept
confirmSortAgain: Save “{name}” and apply its rule to every email already kept? Values set by hand are left as they are.
sortedAgain: {examined, plural, one {# email} other {# emails}} looked at, {changed, plural, =0 {none changed} one {# changed} other {# changed}}.
skill: Download the skill for an AI agent
noteUser: Set by hand: sorting leaves it as it is
noteNobody: Neither a rule nor a member decided it
noteByHand: A value you choose here stays as you put it.
byRule: A rule decides it when an email is fetched
